integrity: Exact linear-algebra proof is provided; a dimension-three numerical checker supplements but cannot replace the proof; source comparisons are provisional and no independent verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on a SIC existing in the stated dimension; only two deletions of original unconditioned effects are treated; the unknown-norm classification is proved in dimensions at least four; no noise bound is asserted; priority against all historical formulations is not independently established.
title: Exact two-outcome erasure fibers of symmetric informationally complete measurements
